content: @solana/wallet-adapter-react (0.15.39) + wallet-adapter-react-ui + wallet-adapter-base remain the mature, battle-tested wallet-connection layer, unchanged in ~1 year (stable, huge tutorial/example base, auto-detects installed wallets via Wallet Standard). Solana's official docs now also show a newer Next.js pattern built on @solana/client + @solana/react-hooks + @solana/kit (packages created Nov 2025), but this stack is under a year old with a much smaller ecosystem of examples.
